name: Tour Plan 03: Heritage & Nature Grandeur
short_description: A 10 Days / 9 Nights journey exploring Sigiriya, Polonnaruwa, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Ella, and Galle.
description:
DAY 01 - 03: SIGIRIYA & POLONNARUWA

Upon arrival, transfer to Sigiriya for a 2-night stay. Explore the heart of the Cultural Triangle.

  • Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress: Climb the 5th-century UNESCO citadel.
  • Hiriwadunna Village Tour: Experience authentic Sri Lankan rural life and a traditional lunch.
  • Wildlife Safari: Visit Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Eco Park to witness the 'Gathering' of wild elephants.
  • Dambulla Cave Temple: Marvel at the ancient murals and golden statues.
  • Polonnaruwa: One day visit to the ancient heritage site.

Stay: Sigiriya (3 Nights)

DAY 04 - 05: KANDY

Proceed to the hill capital of Kandy.

  • Herbal & Spice Garden: Learn about Sri Lanka's world-renowned spices.
  • Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic: Visit the most sacred Buddhist site in the country.
  • Kandy View Point & Gem Museum: Panoramic city views and a glimpse into the jewelry industry.
  • Royal Botanical Gardens: A stroll through the lush gardens of Peradeniya.
  • Cultural Dance Show: An evening of traditional Kandyan drumming and fire walking.

Stay: Kandy (2 Nights)

DAY 06 – 08: NUWARA ELIYA & ELLA

  • Gregory Lake: Enjoy a serene lakeside walk and water activities.
  • Victoria Park: Explore the beautiful gardens of Little England.
  • Moon Plains: A 360-degree view of the surrounding mountain ranges.
  • Ramboda Waterfall & Tea Factory: Scenic tea tasting and waterfall views en route.
  • Little Adam's Peak & Nine Arch Bridge: Iconic hikes and architectural wonders.

Stay: Nuwara Eliya (1 Night) & Ella (2 Nights)

DAY 09 - 10: GALLE & DEPARTURE

Final night in Galle. Activities: Madu River Boat Safari (mangroves) and a visit to a Turtle Hatchery.

Stay: Galle (1 Night)

name: Tour Plan 05: Ultimate Sri Lankan Expedition
short_description: A 15 Days / 14 Nights ultimate expedition through Sri Lanka's historical kingdoms, beaches, wildlife, and tea country.
description:
DAY 01 - 02: ANURADHAPURA

Explore the first kingdom of Sri Lanka. Includes Wilpattu National Park Safari, the Ancient City, and Mihintale Temple.

DAY 03 - 04: TRINCOMALEE

Relax on the white sands of Nilaveli Beach, snorkel at Pigeon Island, and visit the Koneswaram Temple.

DAY 05 - 06: SIGIRIYA & KANDY

  • Sigiriya Lion Rock: Climb the 5th-century ancient rock fortress and palace ruin.
  • Hiriwadunna Village Tour: Experience authentic rural life with a traditional lunch.
  • Wildlife Safari: Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Eco Park safari to see wild elephant gatherings.
  • Dambulla Cave Temple: Marvel at the UNESCO-listed ancient murals and golden statues.
  • Herbal & Spice Garden: Explore the origins of Ceylon & world-famous spices.
  • Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic: Visit the most revered Buddhist temple in Sri Lanka.
  • Kandy View Point: Panoramic views of the hill capital and the Kandy Lake.
  • Gem Museum: A glimpse into the island & rich jewelry and gemstone history.
  • Royal Botanical Garden: Stroll through the lush, historical gardens of Peradeniya.
  • Cultural Dance Show: An evening of traditional drumming, dance, and fire walking.

DAY 09 - 10: NUWARA ELIYA

A 2-night stay including a morning trek at Horton Plains National Park (World's End).

DAY 11 - 15: ELLA, YALA, GALLE

Complete the loop with 2 nights in Ella for hiking, 1 night in Yala for the leopard safari, and a final night in Galle.
